name: Sagawa Mito
source:
Is in the same fourth year as Tastuhiko and Misaki. A truant, who doesn't attend the university, much.

There is a rumour that she invites girls to dangerous parties. Has a bad reputation from the surroundings.
 
Gives an overly seductive feeling, unappropriate for her age.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=420145]Getchu[/url]]
